title: Old Folks at Home
commons_title: File:Foster - Schumann-Heink - Old Folks at Home (rec. 1918).ogg
composition: words and music by Stephen Foster (1851); public domain
credit: Performed by Ernestine Schumann-Heink (1918); this recording is public domain on Wikimedia Commons. One couplet of Foster's original chorus is omitted: it uses a term this catalogue will not print.
lyrics: Way down upon the Swanee River
There's where my heart is turning ever
There's where the old folks stay
All up and down the whole creation
Still longing for the old plantation
And for the old folks at home
